description: h basis test: is dP/dh shaped like a k-rescaling dP/dlnk? ap_corr2 = single-feature R^2 of the AP template; ap_partial = its unique variance after partialling out P. Both small + corr negative => NOT AP.
verdict: AP/k-rescaling hypothesis NOT supported: dP/dh is weakly (negatively) correlated with dP/dlnk (~-0.25) and the template explains ~6% of the variance -> h is weak/under-determined.
